name: yrsa
description: An older woman in her sixties, a proud cook. A warm, full, lively voice, bossy and fond, medium-low.
reference_text: Out of my kitchen, all of you! No, not you, you can stay and stir. Slowly! It's a stew, not a battle. A pinch of salt, a little thyme, and patience. Do you smell that? That is what a home smells like. Now taste it, and tell me I'm wrong.
